note: Rejudged at HEAD after checkPPPCodeReject replaced fail(7, parseErr) with pppCodeRejectFailure(name, 7, parseErr) inside Wait callbacks (identical behavior). Re-read RFC 1661 Section 5.6: 'The Identifier field MUST be changed for each Code-Reject sent.' Unit tests TestRFC1661LCPCodeRejectIdentifierChanges and TestRFC1661NCPCodeRejectIdentifierChanges send two unknown-code packets sharing one Identifier (0x41 for LCP, 0x51 for IPCP and IPv6CP) and assert two distinct Code-Reject Identifiers. Interop checkPPPCodeReject assertion 3 sends two LCP (Code 99) and two IPCP (Code 12) probes all with Identifier 0x42 and asserts distinctIdentifiers. Producers sendCodeReject (lcpCodeRejectID++) and sendNCPCodeReject/nextNCPCodeRejectID (ipcpCodeRejectID++/ipv6cpCodeRejectID++) advance per-protocol counters on every send; the single-polarity annotation holds. Verdict stands.
